headline: Basing above $0.16064 swept low after a capitulation flush

meta.market_state_note: Climactic capitulation + sweep/reclaim of $0.16064 into a tight base — the freefall paused but nothing's reclaimed. The setup is a tactical countertrend bounce, not actionable at spot ($0.171); wait for a dip to $0.165-0.167 or a reclaim of $0.178.

factors.evidence: Severe long-term downtrend — -80% over the window ($0.88 → $0.15). The recent local top $0.26 failed, an orderly grind followed, then a violent liquidation cascade $0.24 → $0.16064. Clean LH/LL.
Price $0.171 below the 20 EMA (computed from daily closes).
Price below; 20 EMA ($0.196) below 50 EMA ($0.207) — bearish stack.
Price ~88% below AVWAP — though the anchor is a far-back cycle high (see Analyst Notes); directionally bearish but not an actionable near-term level.
Below the midline, bearish territory; not at an oversold extreme.
The capitulation days carried ~10x normal volume (36.6M, 19.3M vs ~3M avg); today's bounce light (~5M).
Markdown $0.243 → $0.16064; last ~2.5 days a tight base ($0.165-0.176) holding higher lows above the low. No swing-high reclaim; lower highs intact.
Price $0.1706 is sitting right on the 4H 20 EMA.
RSI rising off the low and above its MA (34.8); mild bullish divergence (price LL $0.16064 then higher lows).
Flush bars ran 6-8M; base bars contracted to 1-3M — sell-side exhaustion.

setup.thesis: Long the oversold divergence / failed-breakdown reversal off the $0.16064 swept capitulation low, targeting mean-reversion into $0.178 then the daily 20 EMA ~$0.196. Tactical, countertrend, unconfirmed.
setup.not: Not Trend Continuation (you'd be shorting into exhaustion at the low); not a clean Pullback (the decline was a breakdown, not an orderly retrace).

verdict.rationale: Tactical countertrend bounce, not a high-conviction trade — it's against a 7/0 bearish bias and unconfirmed. Don't chase at $0.171: wait for a dip into the $0.165-0.167 base to long the bounce, or a confirmed 4H reclaim of $0.178. Invalidation is a close below $0.16064 — and if that gives way, the trade flips to a continuation short toward $0.1506.

evidence_matrix.reading: Price LL $0.16064 then higher lows; RSI ~40 rising above its MA
Basing on $0.16064 swept low, above $0.1506 cycle low
Price ~88% below AVWAP; stale far-back anchor, not reclaimed

analyst_summary: SUSHI is structurally bearish — 7 bearish scorecard factors, zero bullish, price ~-80% and below every mean after a violent liquidation cascade.

But the decline ended in a climactic ~10x capitulation with a long-wick sweep + reclaim of $0.16064, a mild 4H RSI divergence, and selling exhausted into a 2.5-day base — the ingredients for a tactical relief bounce toward $0.178 then the daily 20 EMA ~$0.196.
This is a countertrend, unconfirmed play: long the bounce off the swept low, but a 4H close below $0.16064 flips the bias to a continuation short toward the $0.1506 cycle low.

Caveats: the AVWAP (~$1.42) is a stale far-back anchor and not a usable near-term level; OI/Funding/CVD were unavailable (the climactic volume implies a liquidation flush but can't be confirmed); SUSHI is a high-beta DeFi alt — check BTC before timing entry, as a BTC bounce would fuel the move and continued weakness would kill it.
bottom_line: Countertrend / reversal attempt — a tactical post-capitulation bounce, not trend-following. Buy the dip into $0.165-0.167 or a confirmed reclaim of $0.178; if $0.16064 fails, flip to a short.

bearish_confirmation.title: Bearish Invalidation
bearish_confirmation.subtitle: Thesis Invalidated
bearish_confirmation.result: Long invalidated; flips to continuation short toward $0.1506.

bull_case: Climactic 10x capitulation with a long-wick sweep + reclaim of $0.16064, mild 4H divergence and exhausted selling — fuel for a relief bounce to $0.178 then $0.196.
bear_case: -80% downtrend below every mean with cascade-origin supply $0.20-0.24 overhead — the 2.5-day base is likely a pause before continuation to the $0.1506 cycle low.
failure_scenario: The bounce stalls into the $0.176-0.178 supply, rolls over, the bearish bias reasserts, and price loses $0.16064 toward the $0.1506 cycle low and fresh lows — i.e. the base was a pause, not a bottom.
conclusion: Countertrend / Mean-Reversion Reversal Attempt — explicitly not trend-following.
